description: Verify that Server-reboot recovery via UDP — DUT re-subscribes with new tester UDP port
approach:
[Objective]
_081 UDP variant: DUT must drop the old subscription and resubscribe to the new tester UDP port after the reboot signal.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester ⇄ DUT: SubscribeEventgroup with UDP option.
3. Tester → DUT: simulated reboot OfferService.
4. Observation: DUT emits new Subscribe targeting the new UDP port.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT resubscribed via new UDP port — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_first_subscribe: No DUT Subscribe with UDP option within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_second_subscribe: DUT did not re-subscribe after simulated reboot
